name: Hesketh's gangway token
description: A brass tally stamped with a tern in flight, worn smooth by a hundred thumbs. Show it to the crew at the gangway and the rope comes down.
notes: Opens the tern-gangway gate (mw-e40.28). Captain Hesketh hands it over on either route aboard: Tereza's vouch or the crew deal (hesketh-gilded-tern). Reusable, so it stays on the keyring. Placeholder text until e39-item-creature-text.
